reference_image.usage_description: Use only the exact rigid mask design in this reference: white porcelain, dark curved flame lines, a small red center dot, a single thin curved lower line ending in two hooks. Copy this design onto the small character masks in the input sheet. The anime photograph is design reference only; keep native pixel-art rendering.

description: This is a 3x3 sprite grid of eight separate 80x80 animation frames, with final bottom-right cell empty. Preserve all eight characters at exactly the same locations and sizes and facing directions. Edit ONLY their masks to match the supplied reference, consistently across all visible faces. The mask is a rigid smooth ivory full-face plate bearing fixed dark gray curving flame marks, a small RED central dot, and a SINGLE THIN curved lower marking with hooks. No open mouth, teeth or human eyes. Bangs overlap the mask. Back-view frames show only hair and must stay unchanged. Keep body, hair, sword, hand pose, boots and coat unchanged. Preserve 80x80 cells, the 240x240 canvas, empty final cell, transparency and hard pixel-art edges. No resizing or labels.
